1.text: Tha elder 2 tha elect lady N her children, whom I love in tha truth; N not I only, but also all dey dat have known tha truth;
4 tha truth’s sake, which lives in us, N shall be wit us 4 ever.
Grace be wit u, mercy, N peace, from God tha Father, N from tha Lord Jesus Christ, tha Son of tha Father, in truth N love.
I rejoiced greatly dat I found of ur children walkin in truth, as we have received a commandment from tha Father.
N now I beg u, lady, not as though I wrote a new commandment 2 u, but dat which we had from tha beginning, dat we love one another.
N dis is love, dat we walk after his commandments. dis is tha commandment, dat, as y’all have heard from tha beginning, y’all should walk in it.
4 many deceivers r entered in2 tha world, who confess not dat Jesus Christ is come in tha flesh. dis is a deceiver N an antichrist.
Look 2 y’all, dat we lose not dose things which we have wrought, but dat we receive a full reward.
Whoever transgresseth, N abides not in tha doctrine of Christ, has not God. He dat abides in tha doctrine of Christ, he has both tha Father N tha Son.
If there come any 2 u, N bring not dis doctrine, receive him not in2 ur house, neither bid him God speed:
4 he dat tells him God speed is partaker of his evil deeds.
Havin many things 2 write 2 u, I would not write wit paper N ink: but I trust 2 come 2 u, N speak face 2 face, dat our joy may be full.
Tha children of ur elect sister greet u. Amen.
